ios.desc:
The #1 Language App for Expats, Nomads, & Travelers
Join 100,000+ who learned useful language skills in just 2 weeks!

PRETTYFLUENT IS:
- Your lessons. Ridiculously fast.
- Language skills to thrive in any setting
- Used by thousands of loyal travelers
- Practicing to speak only what you will use
- Reaching all your goals abroad

--------------

LEARN:
- Ordering a coffee
- Flirting at the bar
- Small talk and making friends
- Business meetings
- Industry jargon
- Making party reservations
- Meeting your father-in-law
- Shopping for culinary essentials
- Talking about your favorite shows
- Street slang
If you can dream, it we can teach it.

--------------

The PrettyFluent app is simple:

SHORT, BITE-SIZED LESSONS
Complete one, two, three, or more a day

LEARN FUN, USEFUL SCENARIOS
Learn only what you need to know

LISTEN, SPEAK, AND REPEAT
Use the language like a native

ROLEPLAY & CUSTOMIZATION
Practice your real-life situation/topic

-------------

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
Perfect for travelers, nomads, and expats who want to 
- learn and speak Mandarin (Simplified & Traditional Chinese)
- learn and speak French
- learn and speak German
- learn and speak Italian
- learn and speak Japanese
- learn and speak Spanish (Spain & Mexican)
- learn and speak Portuguese
Contact us if you need support for another language.

-------------

START SPEAKING TODAY
Download PrettyFluent and unlock new experiences and relationships tomorrow.

Free to download. Premium features such as custom lesson requests will require a subscription.
This app uses Apple's standard End User License Agreement (EULA). You can view the standard Apple EULA at: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Shameless plug of my language app, dangerous.

Our language app is largely based on using LLMs and spaced-repetition. We explain the context behind every word and phrase, provide additional usage examples and cultural notes, and also use speech recognition to test recall and pronunciation.

We're invite-only at the moment, but happy to pass along invite codes to anybody who may find it useful.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dangerous-language-skills/id6741348848
quotes.story_title: Spaced repetition systems have gotten better
